svg.text: 121GW Bluetooth packet (firmware 1.10-2.05): 19 bytes, about 2 per second
USART2 19200 8N1 to the BLE112; built by BLE_BuildPacket (0x0800C5DA). Multi-byte fields are big-endian.
header (date stamp + meter ID, packed BCD)
date stamp year, 2 BCD digits (EEPROM 0x01, YY*100+MM; set in factory mode)
meter ID digit 5 (ten-thousands); meter ID = EEPROM 0x03, SETUP page 8
main mode 0-24 (g_mode: 0 LowZ, 1 DCV, 2 ACV, 3 DCmV, 4 ACmV, 5 temp, ... 24 DC VA)
temperature mode only: 5 = deg C, 4 = deg F
range index (diode: 1 when the 15 V test is on)
main value |v| bits 15-0 (18-bit magnitude, sign in byte 6)
sub code: SETUP page shown, e.g. 100 deg C, 105 deg F, 110 battery, 120/125 APO on/off,
130 year, 135 date, 140 time, 160 contrast, 180 dBm, 150 burden; 6 frequency; 0 = blank
sub flags: decimal places, k / Hz unit bits (per field)
sub value, magnitude (date and time pages: one byte each)
bargraph off (Hz, pulse, duty, capacitance, temperature)
per-sample reading negative (bar on the minus side)
1 kHz LPF on / 1 ms PEAK on
AUTO range / auto power-off enabled / low battery
Bluetooth on / high-voltage warning icon (>= 30 V)
REL on / dBm page (ACV, SETUP page 11)
MIN/MAX state 1 MAX, 2 MIN, 3 AVG, 4 all; in 1 ms PEAK 1 max, 2 min
Never set by 2.05's builder: byte 15 bit 7, byte 16 bit 7 (deg C / deg F icons), byte 17 bits 1-0 (AC / DC icons), byte 17 bit 6.
Older firmware: 1.00-1.09 send F2 + 52 ASCII hex characters + CR LF instead; 1.57-2.00 send 19 zero bytes before the first packet.
Frames the meter accepts: ASCII hex after the header byte (upper case only); valid frames are echoed
Key byte = the hex pair, sent twice; both copies must match. 0x01-0x08 short, 0x81-0x88 long.
1 RANGE, 2 HOLD, 3 REL, 4 1ms PEAK, 5 MODE, 6 MIN/MAX, 7 MEM, 8 SETUP. Example: F4 '0' '5' '0' '5' = short MODE.
Each field is a binary byte written as two hex characters (2026 -> "1A"). A frame with a bad XOR is ignored.
Written to the NJU6350 clock chip once per Bluetooth session (re-armed by the long 1ms PEAK that turns Bluetooth on).
